baslik: Healthy Lifestyle, Nutrition & Mental Well-Being Vocabulary
paragraflar: Nutrition & Physical Health: Balanced diet, nutritious food, stay hydrated, cut down on junk food, take up a sport ve work out sağlıklı yaşamın temel söz varlığıdır.
Mental Well-Being: Cope with stress, mindfulness, emotional resilience, limit screen time ve quality sleep pattern ruhsal iyilik hâlini destekler.
